name: file-catalog
desc: Free, open-source disk catalog for Windows — index drives and offline media, search anything by name later. 100 MB portable, MIT.
features: ✅ **Index any drive or folder** — builds a fast local database of names, sizes and dates, including USB and optical media
✅ **Search offline media** — find files on a disconnected external drive without plugging it in
✅ **Multi-volume catalogs** — keep several drives in one searchable index with volume labels and icon tags
✅ **Search syntax** — filter by extension, size range, date window and wildcard patterns combined
✅ **Export catalogs** — CSV, HTML or TXT listings for insurance, audits or sale inventories
✅ **Incremental refresh** — rescan only changed folders instead of the entire drive
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — SQLite bundled, portable, offline, MIT with SHA-256 releases
compare: | Combined search syntax | **Yes** | Basic | Yes | Yes |
| HTML and CSV export | **Yes** | Partial | Partial | Yes |
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Zip | Mac only | Installer |
faqQ: how to catalog files on external drives and search them offline?
faqA: Hunting for a file across six bare drives means plugging each one in and waiting, often per search. file-catalog snapshots each drive into a local database so you search every archive at once, then plug in only the winner. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, offline with no account.
